Compare Pooling Effects

Source: R/ppc_functions.R
compare_pooling.Rd

Compares parameter estimates between pooled and unpooled two-sex models to assess the effect of partial pooling.

Usage

compare_pooling(fit_pooled, fit_unpooled, params = NULL)

Arguments

fit_pooled

CmdStanMCMC object from a pooled two-sex model.

fit_unpooled

CmdStanMCMC object from an unpooled two-sex model.

params

Character vector of parameter names to compare. If NULL, uses c("Linf", "L0", "k").

Value

A data.table with parameter comparisons.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
comp <- compare_pooling(growth_pooled, growth_unpooled)
print(comp)
} # }
